title: Transportation Research Symposium
about: Call for abstracts for the second Transportation Research Symposium, organised by Elsevier at Singapore Expo, 11-14 July 2027. Abstracts are due 22 January 2027; author notification by 19 March 2027.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis

field "Transportation research" → objective "Transform complex information into research briefs, comparison matrices, executive summaries, and actionable recommendations."
